name: Reprojected Spatial Hash Map Indices
definition: An optimization for spatial hash lookups in temporal rendering. It splits the RTAO pass into two steps: reprojection of indices from the previous frame if history/checksum is valid, and a fullscreen pass using the index texture. This reduces atomic memory operations.
summary: Reprojected Spatial Hash Map Indices optimize temporal volume rendering by reusing previous frame hash indices via a texture buffer, reducing expensive atomic memory operations.
